/-!
# Erdős Problem 246

*References:*
- [erdosproblems.com/246](https://www.erdosproblems.com/246)
- [Bi59] Birch, B. J., *Note on a problem of Erd\H{o}s*. Proc. Cambridge
  Philos. Soc. (1959), 370-373.
- [Ca60] Cassels, J. W. S., *On the representation of integers as the sums of
  distinct summands taken from a fixed set*. Acta Sci. Math. (Szeged) (1960),
  111-124.
- [FaCh17] Fang, Jin-Hui and Chen, Yong-Gao, *A quantitative form of the
  {E}rd\H{o}s-{B}irch theorem*. Acta Arith. (2017), 301--311.
- [He00b] Hegyv\'{a}ri, N., *On the completeness of an exponential type
  sequence*. Acta Math. Hungar. (2000), 127--135.
- [Yu24] Yu, Wang-Xing, *On the representation of an exponential type sequence*.
  Publ. Math. Debrecen (2024), 253--261.
-/

namespace Erdos246

/-- The set $\{a^k b^l : k,l \geq 0\}$. -/
def Gamma (a b : ℕ) : Set ℕ :=
  {x | ∃ k l : ℕ, x = a ^ k * b ^ l}

/--
Let $(a,b)=1$. The set $\{a^kb^l: k,l\geq 0\}$ is complete - that is, every large integer is the sum of distinct integers of the form $a^kb^l$ with $k,l\geq 0$.

We state the nontrivial case $a,b\geq 2$, proved by Birch [Bi59].
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 11,
  formal_proof using lean4 at "https://github.com/plby/lean-proofs/blob/main/src/v4.29.1/ErdosProblems/Erdos246.lean"]
theorem erdos_246 (a b : ℕ) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) :
    IsAddComplete (Gamma a b) := by
  sorry

end Erdos246

reformulations.difference: Completeness uses eventual membership in `subsetSums` along `Filter.atTop`; the cited formal proof instead uses finiteness of the complement of the subset sums.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: Unfolding the repository definitions gives ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, ∃ F : Finset ℕ, ↑F ⊆ Gamma a b ∧ n = ∑ x ∈ F, x. This is exactly representation of every sufficiently large natural by distinct permitted integers. On ℕ, `Nat.cofinite_eq_atTop` makes this equivalent to finiteness of the complement. Both equivalences and the universally quantified statement equivalence were proved in the scratch file.

review.notes:
Both declarations are faithful. In particular, Fang–Chen's Theorem A explicitly assumes coprime integers greater than 1, justifying `2 ≤ a` and `2 ≤ b`. The definitions correctly include zero exponents and prohibit repeated summand values. Boundary proofs and finite computations passed in `/workspace/review/scratch.lean`.

The live problem page was Cloudflare-blocked; its archived page and the current linked database both record proved/Lean status. After proof-script-only compatibility edits from Lean/Mathlib 4.29.1 to the sandbox's 4.33.1, the cited proof and a bridge to the exact repository statement compiled in `/workspace/review/verified-bridge.lean`. `#print axioms Review246.reproduced_exact_statement` reports only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`. The audited file remains byte-identical to the specified commit.
